verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a reasonable question for a payments platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack documents no scheduling capability. The nearest items are event-driven webhooks, offline payment auto-forwarding, on-demand Instant Payouts and Smart Disputes automation. These are triggered or one-off actions, not recurring schedules, so they do not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
